necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0) and supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1). To further characterize the arrhythmia burden and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances, a cardiac event monitoring study (CPT 93271) is indicated for extended ambulatory assessment. This service addresses the specific clinical indication of correlating symptoms with rhythm disturbances as stated in the clinical note.
